dedupe_keys.name: zipcheckup us water quality and safety dataset

description: ZipCheckup publishes a US ZIP-code table of drinking-water quality and related home-safety indicators. Its repository README describes 42,679 ZIP records, of which 23,795 have mapped water-system data, drawn from 66 federal and state sources. Users can select a ZIP and source fields from compressed CSV or JSON exports to prepare exposure or service context. Geographic coverage is the United States at ZIP-code scale, with source vintages varying by field. The README states CC BY 4.0 with attribution. A material limitation is that a retired legacy file mixed copper units and understated some values by a factor of 1,000; the current export omits unverified copper concentrations and uses an exceedance flag. ZIP aggregation also cannot identify an individual home's tap water. The data can support screening scenarios for drinking-water infrastructure. The related catalogue EPANET model is a hydraulic simulator, not this exposure table. No compressed dataset was downloaded.
name: ZipCheckup US water quality and safety dataset
notes: G7 G7-1700. Prepared draft only. Metadata review on 2026-09-28; no models, data or archives downloaded. Related-resource comparisons are reviewer mappings, not tested interoperability. Use current export only. Provider warns a retired legacy copper field mixed units and understated some values by 1000x.
schema_summary: ZIP-code water system violations, typed lead/copper evidence, PFAS, radon, flood and demographic fields
